```{r}

starter_path <- "C:/Users/SethJ/OneDrive/Desktop/U of A/Spring 2025/Sports Analytics/CBB-project/ncaahoopR_data"
```

```{r}
acc <- c("Boston_College", "Clemson", "Duke", "Florida_State", "Georgia_Tech",
         "Louisville", "Miami", "NC_State", "UNC", "Notre_Dame",
         "Pitt", "Syracuse", "UVA", "Virginia_Tech", "Wake_Forest")

big12 <- c("Baylor", "BYU", "Cincinnati", "Houston", "Iowa_State", "Kansas", "Kansas_State", "Oklahoma", "Oklahoma_State", "TCU", "Texas", "Texas_Tech", "UCF", "West_Virginia")

big10 <- c("Illinois", "Indiana", "Iowa", "Maryland", "Michigan", "Michigan_State", "Minnesota", "Nebraska", "Northwestern", "Ohio_State", "Penn_State", "Purdue", "Rutgers", "Wisconsin")

  
pac12 <- c("Arizona", "Arizona_State","Cal", "Colorado", "Oregon", "Oregon_State", "Stanford", "UCLA", "USC", "Utah",  "Washington", "Washington_St")

sec <- c("Alabama", "Arkansas", "Auburn", "Florida", "Georgia", "Kentucky", "LSU", "Ole_Miss", "Miss_St", "Missouri", "South_Carolina", "Tennessee", "Texas_A&M", "Vanderbilt")

teams <- c(acc, big12, big10, pac12, sec)
seasons <- c("2019-20", "2020-21", "2021-22", "2022-23", "2023-24")
```

```{r}
allData <- data.frame()

for(tmInd in 1:length(teams)) {
  currTm <- teams[tmInd]
  print(currTm)
  for(sznInd in 1:length(seasons)) {
    currSzn <- seasons[sznInd]
    
    print(currSzn)
    flush.console()
    
    currPath <- paste0(starter_path, "/", currSzn, "/", "schedules/", currTm, "_schedule.csv")
    
    currData <- read.csv(currPath)
    currData$team <- currTm
    
    allData <- rbind(allData, currData)
  }
}
```
```{r}
write.csv(allData, "gameResults.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
